setup.title: Pip's Muddy Day
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic, natural documentary footage of a dog's day from beach to farm to home.

cast.name: Pip
cast.description: Pip, one black-and-white border collie with a white blaze slightly left of center, one black ear raised and one folded, one white-tipped front paw, and a teal collar with a round silver tag.

extras.music: Playful pizzicato strings with a light marimba, kept at low volume throughout.

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a quiet sandy beach in early morning light, where Pip charges across the shoreline with a tennis ball. Pip, a clean and glossy black-and-white border collie with an off-center white blaze and a teal collar with a silver tag, charges along the wet sand. Clamping a bright yellow-green tennis ball securely between her jaws, she gallops along the water's edge before sweeping into a wide curve. She circles back smoothly and sprints straight toward the viewer with focused eyes, holding the ball tight as ocean swells break behind her. A low-angle tracking shot moves backward just above the sand, keeping Pip in dynamic full-body view as she runs.

shots.prompt: A low medium shot of the foaming ocean shallows in morning light, where Pip bounds into the gentle surf. Pip, a black-and-white border collie with mismatched ears and a teal collar, drops her yellow tennis ball into the shallow seafoam. She splashes energetically through the cresting wavelets, scoops the ball back up, and trots out onto the wet sand. Her coat is now thoroughly soaked, flattened, and dripping with seawater. Halting on the shore, she vigorously shakes her entire body from head to tail, releasing an explosive burst of glistening water spray. The camera tracks smoothly at eye level, capturing her splash into the surf and her full-body shake on the sand.

shots.prompt: A low-angle close-up of the sunny upper beach at midday, where Pip rolls in the dry golden sand. Pip, a soaking wet black-and-white border collie with flat drenched fur and a teal collar, drops onto her side and rolls onto her back. She squirmingly paddles her paws in the air, rubbing her head, chest, and shoulders into the powdery dry sand. Loose golden grains cling instantly to her damp fur. When she clambers back onto all fours, her wet coat and teal collar are heavily crusted in a thick, gritty layer of beach sand. The camera holds a low-angle close-up at dog height, tilting slightly as she rolls on the ground and rising as she stands.

shots.prompt: A low-angle medium shot of a weathered wooden boardwalk cutting through coastal dunes, where Pip trots inland. Pip, a black-and-white border collie with an off-center white blaze and a damp coat crusted with sand, trots briskly along the graying timber planks. Her plume-like tail wags high as she ascends the gentle incline toward inland farmland. Small flecks of loose beach sand dislodge from her fur with each step, but a thick gritty texture remains clearly embedded across her white chest, muzzle, and flanks. The camera tracks backward smoothly ahead of Pip at dog-eye level, keeping her determined trot centered.

shots.prompt: A wide shot of an expansive green pasture in soft daylight, where Pip herds a grazing flock of sheep. Pip, a black-and-white border collie with a teal collar and sandy residue clinging to her dark flanks, pauses on the lush grass. She drops low into a classic herding crouch with her dark eyes locked on the grazing sheep ahead. Springing forward into a swift gallop, she sweeps around the flock in a wide, sweeping arc. Her wind-ruffled, sand-dusted coat flashes against the green sod as she steers the sheep inward. The camera holds a sweeping wide shot at pasture height, gently panning across the field to track Pip's curving path.

shots.prompt: A medium shot of a churned dirt farm track under overcast skies, where Pip charges into a large mud puddle. Pip, an energetic black-and-white border collie with a light dusting of sand on her coat, sprints at full speed after a stray lamb. She bounds straight into a massive, murky brown mud puddle. A violent spray of muddy water and thick wet silt erupts into the air as she splashes through the hollow. Scrambling out onto the damp grass, her legs, belly, and previously white chest are completely caked in dripping dark brown mud, with thick muck spattering her teal collar. The camera tracks smoothly at dog eye-level, panning to follow her explosive leap through the puddle and onto the grass.

shots.prompt: A low close-up of a farm pasture in bright diffuse daylight, where Pip sits covered in thick mud. Pip, a black-and-white border collie with her off-center blaze and mismatched ears, sits proudly upright in the grass. Thick dark brown mud heavily cakes her white chest, belly, and legs, with wet flecks splattered across her cheeks and muzzle. Panting with a wide, happy grin and her tongue lolling out, she tilts her head curiously and swishes her tail through the damp grass. The camera stays in a low, subtly stabilized close-up at Pip's eye level, keeping the resting sheep softly out of focus behind her.

shots.prompt: A low-angle medium shot of a gravel farmyard in late-afternoon light, where Pip trots toward a red farmhouse door. Pip, a black-and-white border collie heavily splattered with dark farm mud from her paws to her ears, trots purposefully across the pale stone yard. Her teal collar and round silver tag carry flecks of dirt, and her feathered tail swishes gently. With every step, her muddy paws leave a distinct trail of dark, damp prints across the light gravel. She continues at a steady, contented pace, heading directly toward the weathered red door of the stone house. The camera tracks smoothly alongside Pip in a low-angle glide, matching her walking pace while keeping her muddy tracks and the red door in view.

shots.prompt: A medium shot of a rustic farmhouse bathroom, where Pip stands inside a vintage galvanized tub as warm water streams over her muddy coat. Pip, a black-and-white border collie with an off-center white blaze, one upright ear, and one folded ear, stands muddy inside the galvanized tub. Her teal collar is unclipped and placed on the metal rim as warm water rinses her dirt-caked fur. Dog shampoo is worked into a creamy lather across her coat, creating a puff of white foam between her mismatched ears. Brown, gritty water drains beneath her paws, leaving her completely soaked and covered in soapy suds. The camera holds a steady, eye-level medium shot framing Pip squarely inside the metal wash tub.

shots.prompt: A slow-motion close-up in the steamy farmhouse bathroom, where Pip stands drenched and lathered in white soap foam. Pip, the black-and-white border collie without her collar, stands dripping wet with thick white lather across her chest and head. She squints her eyes shut and begins a violent, slow-motion body shake. Water droplets and fluffy clumps of foam fly outward in sweeping arcs, spraying across the steamy room. Her mismatched ears flap wildly until the suds are completely flung free, leaving her clean coat flattened and soaking wet. The camera holds a slow-motion close-up centered tightly on Pip's face and upper torso as droplets spin outward.
